events.title: shades of sound ft. orthodox
events.description: ease into the weekend with a live mix of jazz, funk, and reggae, bringing groove-driven rhythms and good energy to your friday night.

events.title: tahaja hills sketch meet
events.description: spend the morning sketching outdoors alongside fellow artists, surrounded by the hills of bhaktapur.

events.title: kathmandu heritage run
events.description: explore the city’s historic neighborhoods on a 10 km community run, open to both regular runners and beginners.

events.title: nepa-quest 10k run 2026
events.description: join runners of different ages and experience levels, with separate categories for elite, youth, and masters. registration includes an event t-shirt and finisher medal, with prizes for winners.

events.title: hike for a change
events.description: spend a morning outdoors hiking toward tarebhir while giving back to nature through trail clean-up, tree planting, and shared activities. the hike takes around 4–5 hours, including breaks.

events.title: newar buddhism in nepal: the baha bahis
events.description: explore the history, rituals, and living traditions of newa buddhist monasteries through a documentary screening, followed by a q&a with the filmmakers.

events.title: what’s on your plate?
events.description: bring a favorite dish or snack to share with 3–4 people, and spend an afternoon connecting with other women over food, games, stories, and conversation.

events.title: what remains unseen
events.description: a new exhibition presented by dot line space art foundation and gallery mcube, opening november 3 and on view until november 20.

events.title: solar cyborg: amble skuse in conversation with nirvik maskey
events.description: explore an experimental art project featuring a cyborg with solar-powered wings and a mirrored helmet equipped with cameras and microphones.

events.title: tihar mela
events.description: browse food, crafts, and local products at a two-day festive market celebrating tihar. runs november 6–7.

events.title: पही run
events.description: ditch your usual running gear and join a playful 5 km community run where anything goes, except running clothes! show up in something unexpected and enjoy a fun morning on the move.

events.title: lalitpur metropolis-wide running competition
events.description: lace up and join runners from across lalitpur for a city-wide race, with a 10 km men’s run and 5 km women’s run. prizes, medals, and trophies await, with limited spots available.

events.title: 13th maitidevi street festival
events.description: enjoy an afternoon of live rock music, traditional dance, and cultural performances, with cobweb and shree 3 band taking the stage for a lively neighborhood celebration.

events.title: conversation with srijan thapa and prawin adhikari
events.description: join artist srijan thapa and writer and educator prawin adhikari for a conversation exploring art, ideas, and creative practice.

events.title: astra temple quest 2083
events.description: team up with a friend for a 10–15 km adventure through bhaktapur, combining running, hidden temple discoveries, clue-solving, and checkpoint challenges. limited slots available.

events.title: abhyāsa: tradition in the making
events.description: explore paubha paintings created by artists from the drawing room’s advanced course and 15-day intensive, showcasing their learning, practice, and the continuation of a living artistic tradition. on view until november 20.

events.title: astitwa
events.description: explore works by 25 artists bringing together diverse creative practices and perspectives on individuality and artistic expression. on view until november 21.

events.title: writing circle at taragaon next
events.description: bring your ideas and spend an afternoon writing alongside others, sharing thoughts, and connecting with fellow writing enthusiasts in a relaxed community setting.
